node.title: Official exact-slice depths miss the generated-field F2 guard by 129 bits
node.statement: Let N=2^41, rho in {1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16}, K=rho N, 128<=L=log2(q)<256, and t_XR=min{t:tL>=log2 binom(N,N-K-t)+128}. Then t_XR L<=N-129. Since B0=F_p(mu_N) is a subfield of F_q, t_XR log2|B0|<=N-129 as well. Thus every official exact-list corridor depth fails the generated-field guard |B0|^t>=2^N by at least 129 bits, including generating rows. Consequently the guarded full-subset F2 terminal cannot by itself discharge the exact-slice u2c/x4 consumer.
